coverage_note: Source inventory with limited browser observations and local API test evidence. No row proves a complete end-to-end production flow. `status` uses the requested values; `observation_status` preserves partial or prerequisite qualifiers. Production mutations and external actions are excluded until separately authorized. Provider OAuth and each supported manual invitation integration now have separate rows. Cross-role, authorization, affiliate/admin, mobile, and recovery scenarios also have explicit rows. Browser evidence records narrow production UI observations only; API validation records local test evidence only. Neither proves full end-to-end persistence or live provider success. Kit and Zapier are manual capabilities; Zapier has no corresponding invite manual route/config/handler in inspected source.

flows.flow: Token and authorization revocation, cancel, and recovery
flows.prerequisites: Expired or compromised connection; verified user email
flows.steps: Inspect revoke affordance; cancel; confirm in local fixture; retry revoked and foreign-tenant IDs
flows.expected_result: Cancel preserves authorization; confirmed revoke updates token state and audit; repeated or foreign revoke is safe
flows.observed_result: Local security tests reject cross-tenant connection and authorization revocation, suppress caller-supplied agency scope, check audit actor attribution, and deny missing email. Successful provider revocation and persisted token state were not verified. Remaining end-to-end checks are untested.
flows.environment_required: local isolated fixture; production mutation excluded

flows.flow: Zapier manual-flow capability and missing route behavior
flows.prerequisites: Invitation includes Zapier
flows.steps: Attempt selection and follow capability routing; locate route/config/handler for completion
flows.expected_result: Capability must route to a supported manual flow; source currently has no Zapier manual route/config/handler and verification is blocked by this implementation gap
flows.observed_result: Source inspection: Zapier appears in the agency-side manual platform list and in the connector factory manual-flow comment. The client invite capability classifies manual flows, but has no Zapier route segment; manual invite config and API handler also have no Zapier entry. This establishes a source gap, but not whether client-side Zapier invitation is intended. Confirm product scope before treating as defect.
flows.environment_required: source inspection only; local verification blocked
